statement: The official confirmed death toll from the late-August 2026 Nepal-Tibet flash floods will stand at 750 or more at some point between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: Between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-15, figures from the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority of Nepal plus official Chinese tallies for Tibet total 750 or more confirmed dead.
failure_condition: The combined official confirmed death toll stands below 750 at the deadline.
